title: 3D torch glow
description: Adds a 3D glow effect on all torches
body:
# 3D Torch Glow

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/b4zg7qcm/images/867cca210e73ea39e103b3bf70bf76469e3b2b0e.png)

This resource pack adds a glowing outline to all vanilla torches, matching the style of the redstone torch model. The effect creates a more consistent and visually appealing look across all torch types.

It includes copper torches on top of the og pack.

## Credits
Original idea and base work inspired by:  [Glowing Torches](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/glowing-torches)

(Some elements were created by the original author; copper torch variant added by me.)
